ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #13
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Asbabu al- nuzuul? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Asbabu al- nuzuul with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Asbabu al- nuzuul to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Asbabu al- nuzuul has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Asbabu al- nuzuul.

2. Which response best shows understanding of Selected verses Surah al- Furqan? (1 mark)

   D. Say Administration of Zakat has no place in daily life.

6. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   B. Pollute rivers deliberately
   C. Waste food daily
   D. Destroy trees without planting

7. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Refusing to help a neighbour
   B. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   C. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   D. Skipping all moral lessons

8. Which response best shows understanding of Prayers on special occasions? (1 mark)

14. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   B. Hiding stolen items
   C. Spreading rumours
   D. Cheating in exams

15. Which response best shows understanding of Care for widows? (1 mark)
   A. Say Care for widows has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Care for widows with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Care for widows.
   D. Use Care for widows to insult classmates of other faiths.
